items.title: Dear Worship Leader
items.description: Letters to the person holding the microphone — on calling, preparation, correction, team life and the private work that makes public worship honest.

items.title: Prayed Up
items.description: For anyone whose prayer life has become a guilty subject. A return to prayer as something sustained rather than something survived.

items.title: Simple Praying Systems

items.title: Psalms of Ebahi
